source: Brown and Caldwell, SWWRF Wet Weather and Liquid Process Capacity Assessment (July 2014), Section 5.2 'Hydraulic Capacity after Current Recommended Improvements' (PDF p.29) and Section 5.3 'Proposed SWWRF Hydraulic Modifications' (PDF p.32-33); transmittal cover (p.1). Withheld from the agent.
question: Can SWWRF pass the 69 MGD projected peak wet weather flow? What is the hydraulic capacity, what limits it, and what fixes?

items.engineers: Hydraulic capacity (first top-of-wall overtopping) is 40.5 MGD; the limiting unit process at that flow is the filters (filter level held at the 115.3 ft overflow). At 40 MGD no unit is hydraulically challenged.
leak_phrases: limiting unit process at that flow was the filters

items.engineers: At 69 MGD the losses are so large that the hydraulic grade exceeds the top of wall in all simulated process units; headloss also rises through screens, secondary clarifier splitter box, clarifiers and filters.
leak_phrases: exceeded the top of the wall for the simulated process units

items.engineers: Effluent weir channel at the chlorine contact basin; 54-inch pipe filters to CCB; 24-inch filter effluent pipe (Filter #4 to #3); 48-inch pipe secondary clarifiers to filters; 48-inch pipe aeration basin / splitter box to secondary clarifiers.
leak_phrases: Effluent Weir Channel at Chlorine Contact Basin

items.engineers: Store flow above 40.5 MGD for the <24 h storm peak: about 10 MG equalization to cut 69 MGD to 40.5 MGD.
leak_phrases: equalization tank with a volume of approximately 10 MG

items.unit: Option 2: pipe and weir-channel upsizing + equalization
items.engineers: Upsize SC splitter box->SC3 48->54 in, SC3->SC2 36->48 in, SC2->SC1 48->54 in, SC1->filters 48->54 in, filter effluent 24->36 in, filters->CCB 54->60 in, widen CCB effluent weir channel 2->3 ft: passes 50 MGD; still needs ~4.5 MG equalization for 69 MGD.
leak_phrases: Increase Effluent Weir Channel width from 2-ft to 3-ft

items.engineers: All Option 2 upgrades plus a new headworks structure with a 3rd screen, expanded secondary clarifier splitter box, new secondary clarifier #4, new filter #5 and new chlorine contact basin #3.
leak_phrases: Construct and Install a new Filter #5
new Headworks Structure with a 3rd Screen
